name: Hefei Urban Construction Development Co., Ltd
summary: Hefei Urban Construction Development Co., Ltd engages in the real estate development business under the Amber brand name in China. The company develops and constructs residential, commercial, and industrial real estate properties; and office buildings. It is also involved in property management, urban renewal, and leasing activities. In addition, the company offers construction management consulting services. Hefei Urban Construction Development Co., Ltd was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Hefei, China.
